target_matching.source_sector_role: matching stratum and expected archive sector; exact archive metadata is authoritative at product binding

preference_order: highest available official MAST data-release / processing-version metadata
lexicographically smallest stable MAST dataURI/archive key

zero_product_policy: Record MISSING_PRODUCT; retain frozen cohort membership and planned denominator visibility; do not replace event.
multiple_product_policy: Apply the frozen preference order without inspecting scientific flux behavior or AFINO outputs; record all candidate identifiers and chosen product.
physical_hash_policy: SHA-256 every unique downloaded FITS byte stream before opening scientific arrays; shared physical FITS may serve multiple source flares from the same TIC/sector.
fits_checksum_recording_policy: Record FITS CHECKSUM/DATASUM verification status independently of physical SHA-256; checksum warnings do not silently remove cohort members.

time_system_conversion_policy.native_authority: TESS FITS TIME metadata (TIMESYS/BJDREF* and related headers) once the exact product is bound
time_system_conversion_policy.rule: Derive source-marker to native-time comparison only from explicit source/native metadata; do not guess BJD/BTJD offsets.
